_summary.result: JAKIM MYeHALAL Halal Status Verification search returned a server error (PHP fatal error, no results) for every probe query (SugarBun, Marrybrown, Sushi Zanmai, Sofea); outlet-level confirmation was not possible from this source. JAKIM's Verify Halal app and JAIS Sarawak's Jejak Halal app are mobile-only.
